meta.scope: Pharmacy list of commonly prescribed medicines for cardiology, orthopedics, dermatology and gastroenterology, with composition, Indian brands and manufacturers
meta.dosing_note: Dosing is deliberately omitted. Add label-verified, India-specific dosing from the product label or prescribing information.
meta.stock_fields_note: mrp_inr and pack_size are not filled in. Populate them from your stock system or the current pack label. NPPA ceiling prices apply to some formulations, so verify MRP per pack.

brand_source_status.web_confirmed: The brand and manufacturer appeared in a retail pharmacy, manufacturer or trade listing during an earlier lookup. Still confirm against the pack before stocking.
brand_source_status.unverified: From general knowledge and not confirmed. Check the pack, CDSCO records or the manufacturer before loading. Null manufacturer means it was not known.

meta.schedule_note: india_schedule is a general classification: H = prescription (Schedule H), H1 = prescription with additional record-keeping (antibiotics and some controlled items), OTC = over the counter. Only cetirizine (Schedule H) was confirmed in a source. Check the others against the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules.
meta.brand_id_note: Brand IDs BR001 to BR084 are unchanged from v0.2 so existing stock links still work. New brands start at BR085.

india_context.for_doctors: Indian prescriptions are often written by brand name. Map every brand to its generic composition so a prescription for any brand matches stock of the same molecule and strength. Schedule H items need a valid prescription.
india_context.for_patients: Brands from different manufacturers often share the same composition and strength at different prices. Show the generic name and composition next to each brand so patients can compare. Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras stock generic-name medicines; check them for the same molecules.
